document.abstract: (1.1) This standard specifies the dimensions of 35-mm projection reels for motion-picture and television applications and 35-mm and 70-mm projection reels intended for use on combination 70/35-mm projectors and rewinds. (1.2) This standard does not apply to shipping reels as specified in SMPTE ST 192.
